verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-driven inquiry creation (pre-creating inquiries), status polling/data retrieval, and webhooks for real-time status updates, covering create/status/results. However, there is no explicit documentation of retrieving captured media via API, or of cancel/redact endpoints, so the full lifecycle isn't clearly evidenced. missing for 10: documented endpoints for retrieving captured media, and for cancel/redact of an inquiry/session.
